frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 — AI management system (AIMS)
frameworks.description: Requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving an AI management system. Clauses 4–10 plus Annex A reference controls (9 objectives, 38 controls).

requirements.title: Context of the organization
requirements.description: Establish the external/internal context in which the AIMS operates.

requirements.title: Understanding the organization and its context
requirements.description: Determine external/internal issues relevant to purpose; determine the organization's role(s) with respect to AI systems (provider, producer, user/deployer, partner, subject, etc.); consider applicable climate-change relevance (Amd.).
requirements.evidenceHint: Context analysis, AI role statement (EV-POL)

requirements.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
requirements.description: Identify interested parties and their relevant requirements (incl. legal/regulatory, contractual, ethical) for the AIMS and AI systems.
requirements.evidenceHint: Interested-party & requirements register, legal/regulatory register (EV-POL, EV-RISK)

requirements.title: Determining the scope of the AI management system
requirements.description: Define and document AIMS boundaries and applicability, considering 4.1/4.2 and the AI systems/products/services covered.
requirements.evidenceHint: AIMS scope statement (EV-POL)

requirements.title: AI management system
requirements.description: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the AIMS incl. processes and their interactions.
requirements.evidenceHint: AIMS manual / process map (EV-PROC)

requirements.title: Leadership
Leadership and commitment
requirements.description: Top management demonstrates commitment: AI policy & objectives aligned with strategy, resources, integration into business processes, communication, direction/support, promotion of continual improvement.
requirements.evidenceHint: Signed policy, resourcing decisions, leadership communications (EV-POL, EV-MR)

requirements.title: AI policy
requirements.description: Establish an AI policy appropriate to purpose; framework for AI objectives; commitment to applicable requirements and continual improvement; documented, communicated, available to interested parties.
requirements.evidenceHint: AI policy document (EV-POL)

requirements.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
requirements.description: Assign and communicate responsibilities/authorities for AIMS conformance and reporting on AIMS performance.
requirements.evidenceHint: Roles & responsibilities matrix, appointment letters (EV-RACI)

requirements.title: Planning
Actions to address risks and opportunities
General
requirements.description: Determine risks/opportunities to be addressed considering 4.1/4.2; define AI risk criteria (incl. risk acceptance), plan actions and integrate them.
requirements.evidenceHint: Risk criteria statement, risk methodology (EV-PROC, EV-RISK)

requirements.title: AI risk assessment
requirements.description: Define and apply a repeatable AI risk assessment process: identify, analyse (consequences/likelihood), evaluate risks against criteria; prioritise for treatment; retain documented information.
requirements.evidenceHint: AI risk assessment record / risk register (EV-RISK)

requirements.title: AI risk treatment
requirements.description: Select treatment options, determine controls (compare with Annex A), produce Statement of Applicability with justifications for inclusion/exclusion, formulate risk treatment plan, obtain risk-owner approval and acceptance of residual risk.
requirements.evidenceHint: Statement of Applicability, risk treatment plan, residual-risk acceptance (EV-SOA, EV-RISK)

requirements.title: AI system impact assessment
requirements.description: Define and apply a process to assess potential consequences of AI systems for individuals/groups and society across the life cycle; results documented and used in risk assessment.
requirements.evidenceHint: AI system impact assessment (EV-IA)

requirements.title: AI objectives and planning to achieve them
requirements.description: Establish measurable AI objectives consistent with policy; plan what/who/when/how evaluated.
requirements.evidenceHint: AI objectives register & KPI plan (EV-POL)

requirements.title: Planning of changes
requirements.description: Changes to the AIMS carried out in a planned manner.
requirements.evidenceHint: Change plans / change log (EV-CHG)

requirements.title: Support
Resources
requirements.description: Determine and provide resources for the AIMS.
requirements.evidenceHint: Resource plan, budget approvals (EV-MR)

requirements.title: Competence
requirements.description: Determine necessary competence, ensure competence via education/training/experience, take actions and evaluate effectiveness; retain evidence.
requirements.evidenceHint: Training records, competence matrix (EV-TRAIN)

requirements.title: Awareness
requirements.description: Persons aware of AI policy, their contribution, implications of nonconformance.
requirements.evidenceHint: Awareness campaigns, attestations (EV-TRAIN)

requirements.title: Communication
requirements.description: Determine internal/external communications: what, when, with whom, how.
requirements.evidenceHint: Communication plan (EV-COMM)

requirements.title: Documented information
General
requirements.description: AIMS includes documented information required by the standard and determined necessary for effectiveness.
requirements.evidenceHint: Document register (EV-PROC)

requirements.title: Creating and updating
requirements.description: Identification/description, format/media, review and approval for suitability and adequacy.
requirements.evidenceHint: Document control records (EV-PROC)

requirements.title: Control of documented information
requirements.description: Availability/suitability, protection; distribution, access, storage, change control, retention, disposition; control of external documents.
requirements.evidenceHint: Document control procedure, access logs (EV-PROC, EV-LOG)

requirements.title: Operation
Operational planning and control
requirements.description: Plan, implement and control processes to meet requirements and implement 6.x actions; control planned changes, review unintended changes; control externally provided processes/products/services.
requirements.evidenceHint: Operational procedures, process KPIs, change records (EV-PROC, EV-CHG)

requirements.title: AI risk assessment
requirements.description: Perform AI risk assessments at planned intervals or on significant changes; retain results.
requirements.evidenceHint: Periodic risk assessment records (EV-RISK)

requirements.title: AI risk treatment
requirements.description: Implement risk treatment plan; verify effectiveness; re-assess when new risks emerge; retain results.
requirements.evidenceHint: Treatment implementation evidence, control effectiveness tests (EV-RISK, EV-TEST)

requirements.title: AI system impact assessment
requirements.description: Perform AI system impact assessments at planned intervals or on significant changes; retain results.
requirements.evidenceHint: Updated impact assessments (EV-IA)

requirements.title: Performance evaluation
Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
requirements.description: Determine what to monitor/measure, methods, when, who analyses; evaluate AIMS performance and effectiveness; retain evidence.
requirements.evidenceHint: AIMS KPI reports, monitoring dashboards (EV-PMM, EV-TEST)

requirements.title: Internal audit
General
requirements.description: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to confirm AIMS conforms to own requirements and the standard and is effectively implemented.
requirements.evidenceHint: Internal audit report (EV-AUDIT)

requirements.title: Internal audit programme
requirements.description: Plan/establish/maintain audit programme(s): frequency, methods, responsibilities, reporting; define criteria and scope; auditor objectivity; report to management; retain evidence.
requirements.evidenceHint: Audit programme, audit plans, auditor independence records (EV-AUDIT)

requirements.title: Management review
General
requirements.description: Top management reviews the AIMS at planned intervals for suitability, adequacy, effectiveness.
requirements.evidenceHint: Management review minutes (EV-MR)

requirements.title: Management review inputs
requirements.description: Status of prior actions; changes in issues; changes in interested-party needs; AIMS performance incl. nonconformities/CAPA, monitoring results, audit results; opportunities for continual improvement.
requirements.evidenceHint: MR input pack (EV-MR)

requirements.title: Management review results
requirements.description: Decisions on continual improvement opportunities and any needed AIMS changes; retain documented information.
requirements.evidenceHint: MR decisions / action log (EV-MR)

requirements.title: Improvement
Continual improvement
requirements.description: Continually improve suitability, adequacy, effectiveness of the AIMS.
requirements.evidenceHint: Improvement register (EV-AUDIT, EV-MR)

requirements.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
requirements.description: React to nonconformities, evaluate need to eliminate causes, implement actions, review effectiveness, update AIMS if needed; retain evidence of nature of nonconformities, actions and results.
requirements.evidenceHint: Nonconformity & CAPA records (EV-AUDIT)

requirements.title: Policies related to AI
requirements.description: Objective: provide management direction and support for AI systems according to business requirements.

requirements.title: AI policy
requirements.description: Document a policy for development or use of AI systems.
requirements.evidenceHint: AI policy (EV-POL)

requirements.title: Alignment with other organizational policies
requirements.description: Determine where other policies (security, privacy, quality, HR, etc.) are affected by or apply to AI objectives.
requirements.evidenceHint: Policy cross-reference map (EV-POL)

requirements.title: Review of the AI policy
requirements.description: Review AI policy at planned intervals or on significant change for continuing suitability, adequacy, effectiveness.
requirements.evidenceHint: Policy review records (EV-MR)

requirements.title: Internal organization
requirements.description: Objective: establish accountability within the organization to uphold responsible AI.

requirements.title: AI roles and responsibilities
requirements.description: Define and allocate roles and responsibilities for AI according to organizational needs.
requirements.evidenceHint: RACI, job descriptions (EV-RACI)

requirements.title: Reporting of concerns
requirements.description: Define and put in place a process for reporting concerns about the organization's role with respect to an AI system throughout its life cycle.
requirements.evidenceHint: Whistleblowing/concern channel, case log (EV-COMM)

requirements.title: Resources for AI systems
requirements.description: Objective: ensure the organization accounts for the resources (incl. AI system components and assets) of the AI system to fully understand and address risks and impacts.

requirements.title: Resource documentation
requirements.description: Identify and document relevant resources required for AI system activities at given life-cycle stages.
requirements.evidenceHint: Resource inventory per system (EV-INV)

requirements.title: Data resources
requirements.description: Document information about data resources utilized for the AI system (provenance, categories, labelling, intended use, etc.).
requirements.evidenceHint: Datasheets, data inventory (EV-DATA) · Tests: T-DQ

requirements.title: Tooling resources
requirements.description: Document information about tooling resources (frameworks, libraries, pipelines, evaluation tools).
requirements.evidenceHint: Tooling/SBOM-like inventory (EV-INV)

requirements.title: System and computing resources
requirements.description: Document information about system and computing resources (hardware, cloud, compute).
requirements.evidenceHint: Infrastructure inventory, compute records (EV-INV) · Tests: T-ENV

requirements.title: Human resources
requirements.description: Document information about human resources and their competences for development, deployment, operation, change management, maintenance, transfer, decommissioning, verification & integration.
requirements.evidenceHint: Competence matrix, staffing plan (EV-TRAIN, EV-RACI)

requirements.title: Assessing impacts of AI systems
requirements.description: Objective: assess AI system impacts to individuals or groups of individuals, or both, and societies affected by the AI system throughout its life cycle.

requirements.title: AI system impact assessment process
requirements.description: Establish a process to assess potential consequences for individuals/groups/societies throughout the life cycle.
requirements.evidenceHint: Impact assessment procedure (EV-PROC)

requirements.title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
requirements.description: Document results of impact assessments and retain for a defined period.
requirements.evidenceHint: Impact assessment reports (EV-IA)

requirements.title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups of individuals
requirements.description: Assess and document potential impacts on individuals/groups (fairness, safety, privacy, rights, etc.).
requirements.evidenceHint: Individual/group impact section of IA (EV-IA) · Tests: T-BIAS, T-PRIV, T-SAFE

requirements.title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
requirements.description: Assess and document potential societal impacts (environment, economy, democratic processes, health & safety, culture, misuse).
requirements.evidenceHint: Societal impact section of IA (EV-IA) · Tests: T-ENV, T-SAFE

requirements.title: AI system life cycle
Management guidance for AI system development
requirements.description: Objective: ensure the organization identifies and documents objectives and implements processes for responsible design and development of AI systems.

requirements.title: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
requirements.description: Identify and document objectives to guide responsible development and integrate measures to achieve them into the life cycle.
requirements.evidenceHint: Responsible-AI objectives / design principles (EV-POL)

requirements.title: Processes for responsible design and development of AI systems
requirements.description: Define and document specific processes for responsible design and development.
requirements.evidenceHint: Development lifecycle (SDLC/MLOps) procedure (EV-PROC)

requirements.title: AI system life cycle
requirements.description: Objective: define criteria and requirements for each stage of the life cycle.

requirements.title: AI system requirements and specification
requirements.description: Specify and document requirements for new AI systems or material enhancements.
requirements.evidenceHint: Requirements specification (EV-TECHDOC)

requirements.title: Documentation of AI system design and development
requirements.description: Document design and development based on organizational objectives, documented requirements and specification criteria.
requirements.evidenceHint: Design documents, architecture, model cards (EV-TECHDOC)

requirements.title: AI system verification and validation
requirements.description: Define and document verification and validation measures and specify criteria for their use (test methods, test data, release criteria).
requirements.evidenceHint: Test plans & reports, acceptance criteria (EV-TEST) · Tests: T-ACC, T-ROB, T-BIAS, T-SEC, T-HALL, T-SAFE

requirements.title: AI system deployment
requirements.description: Document a deployment plan and ensure requirements are met before deployment.
requirements.evidenceHint: Deployment plan, go-live checklist/approval (EV-CHG) · Tests: T-CONF

requirements.title: AI system operation and monitoring
requirements.description: Define and document necessary elements for ongoing operation (performance monitoring, incident handling, repair, updates, support).
requirements.evidenceHint: Operations runbook, monitoring reports (EV-PMM) · Tests: T-DRIFT

requirements.title: AI system technical documentation
requirements.description: Determine what technical documentation is needed for each interested-party category and provide it in appropriate form.
requirements.evidenceHint: Technical documentation set (EV-TECHDOC)

requirements.title: AI system recording of event logs
requirements.description: Determine at which phases event logs should be enabled, at minimum when the system is in use.
requirements.evidenceHint: Logging configuration, log samples, retention policy (EV-LOG) · Tests: T-LOG

requirements.title: Data for AI systems
requirements.description: Objective: ensure the organization understands the role and impacts of data in AI systems throughout the life cycle.

requirements.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
requirements.description: Define, document and implement data management processes related to development of AI systems (privacy/security, threats, transparency, representativeness, accuracy, integrity).
requirements.evidenceHint: Data management procedure (EV-PROC, EV-DATA) · Tests: T-DQ

requirements.title: Acquisition of data
requirements.description: Determine and document details about acquisition and selection of data (sources, rights, demographics, consent).
requirements.evidenceHint: Data acquisition records, licences, DPAs (EV-DATA, EV-SUP) · Tests: T-IP, T-DQ

requirements.title: Quality of data for AI systems
requirements.description: Define and document data quality requirements and ensure data meets them.
requirements.evidenceHint: Data quality assessment report (EV-DATA) · Tests: T-DQ, T-BIAS

requirements.title: Data provenance
requirements.description: Define and document a process for recording the provenance of data over its life cycle.
requirements.evidenceHint: Provenance/lineage ledger (EV-DATA) · Tests: T-DQ

requirements.title: Data preparation
requirements.description: Define and document criteria and methods for data preparation (cleaning, labelling, transformation, augmentation).
requirements.evidenceHint: Preparation/labelling guidelines, pipeline records (EV-DATA) · Tests: T-DQ

requirements.title: Information for interested parties of AI systems
requirements.description: Objective: ensure relevant interested parties have the necessary information to understand and assess the risks and their impacts.

requirements.title: System documentation and information for users
requirements.description: Determine and provide necessary information to users (purpose, operation, oversight needs, limitations, impacts).
requirements.evidenceHint: Instructions for use, user documentation (EV-UI, EV-TECHDOC) · Tests: T-TRANS

requirements.title: External reporting
requirements.description: Provide capabilities for interested parties to report adverse impacts of the AI system.
requirements.evidenceHint: External reporting channel, case records (EV-COMM)

requirements.title: Communication of incidents
requirements.description: Determine and document a plan for communicating incidents to users.
requirements.evidenceHint: Incident communication plan, notifications sent (EV-INC)

requirements.title: Information for interested parties
requirements.description: Determine and document obligations to report information about the AI system to interested parties (regulators, customers, public).
requirements.evidenceHint: Regulatory reporting register (EV-COMM)

requirements.title: Use of AI systems
requirements.description: Objective: ensure the organization uses AI systems responsibly and per organizational policies.

requirements.title: Processes for responsible use of AI
requirements.description: Define and document processes for the responsible use of AI systems.
requirements.evidenceHint: Acceptable-use procedure for AI (EV-PROC)

requirements.title: Objectives for responsible use of AI system
requirements.description: Identify and document objectives to guide responsible use and integrate measures to achieve them.
requirements.evidenceHint: Responsible-use objectives (EV-POL)

requirements.title: Intended use of the AI system
requirements.description: Ensure the AI system is used according to its intended uses and accompanying documentation.
requirements.evidenceHint: Use-case approval records, usage monitoring (EV-INV, EV-PMM) · Tests: T-DRIFT, T-AGENT

requirements.title: Third-party and customer relationships
requirements.description: Objective: ensure understanding of responsibilities and remain accountable, and risks are apportioned appropriately, when third parties are involved at any life-cycle stage.

requirements.title: Allocating responsibilities
requirements.description: Ensure responsibilities within the AI life cycle are allocated between the organization, its partners, suppliers, customers and third parties.
requirements.evidenceHint: Shared-responsibility matrix, contracts (EV-SUP, EV-RACI)

requirements.title: Suppliers
requirements.description: Establish a process to ensure supplier services/products/materials align with the organization's responsible AI approach.
requirements.evidenceHint: Supplier due-diligence, third-party model cards, SLAs (EV-SUP) · Tests: T-SEC, T-ACC (on supplied models)

requirements.title: Customers
requirements.description: Ensure the organization's responsible AI approach considers customer expectations and needs.
requirements.evidenceHint: Customer requirements analysis, contractual commitments (EV-SUP, EV-COMM)

frameworks.name: EU AI Act — Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)
frameworks.description: Risk-based obligations for AI systems: prohibited practices (Art. 5), high-risk requirements (Arts. 8–15) and obligations (Arts. 16–27), transparency (Art. 50), GPAI models (Arts. 51–56), conformity assessment, registration, post-market monitoring and serious-incident reporting. Annex III high-risk obligations apply from 2 Dec 2027 (Omnibus).

requirements.title: Prohibited AI practices
requirements.description: Bans manipulative/deceptive techniques causing significant harm, exploitation of vulnerabilities, social scoring, individual crime prediction by profiling alone, untargeted facial-image scraping, emotion recognition in workplace/education (except medical/safety), sensitive biometric categorisation, and real-time remote biometric identification for law enforcement (narrow exceptions). Applicable since 2 Feb 2025.
requirements.evidenceHint: Prohibited-practice screening record in the intake assessment (EV-RISK)

requirements.title: Classification rules for high-risk AI systems (Annex I / Annex III)
requirements.description: AI system is high-risk if it is a safety component of (or is itself) a product under Annex I harmonisation legislation requiring third-party conformity assessment, or falls under an Annex III area (biometrics; critical infrastructure; education; employment; essential services incl. credit scoring & insurance; law enforcement; migration/border; justice & democratic processes). Art. 6(3) narrow exemption for procedural/preparatory tasks; profiling is always high-risk.
requirements.evidenceHint: Classification rationale & Annex III area record in the AI inventory (EV-INV, EV-DEC)

requirements.title: Compliance with the requirements
requirements.description: High-risk AI systems comply with Section 2 requirements taking into account intended purpose and generally acknowledged state of the art; providers of Annex I products may integrate AI Act compliance into existing product documentation/procedures.
requirements.evidenceHint: Compliance matrix mapping Arts. 9–15 to controls (EV-SOA-like), integrated technical file (EV-TECHDOC). · Tests: T-CONF.

requirements.title: Risk management system
requirements.description: Establish, implement, document and maintain a continuous iterative risk management system across the life cycle: (a) identify/analyse known and reasonably foreseeable risks to health, safety, fundamental rights under intended purpose; (b) estimate/evaluate risks under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse; (c) evaluate other risks from post-market monitoring data; (d) adopt targeted risk management measures. Residual risk acceptable; eliminate/reduce by design, mitigate/control, provide information and training to deployers. Test against prior-defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds, incl. real-world testing where appropriate (Art. 60), before placing on market. Consider impacts on persons under 18 and other vulnerable groups.
requirements.evidenceHint: Risk management plan & procedure (EV-PROC), risk register with hazard/likelihood/severity/mitigation (EV-RISK), residual-risk acceptance, test-threshold definitions and test results (EV-TEST), PMM-to-risk feedback records (EV-PMM). · Tests: T-ACC (threshold verification), T-ROB, T-SAFE, T-BIAS, T-RT; misuse-scenario testing; real-world/field testing T-UX.

requirements.title: Data and data governance
requirements.description: Training, validation and testing datasets subject to data governance and management practices covering: (a) design choices; (b) data collection processes and origin, original purpose for personal data; (c) preparation operations (annotation, labelling, cleaning, updating, enrichment, aggregation); (d) assumptions about what data measures/represents; (e) assessment of availability, quantity, suitability; (f) examination for possible biases likely to affect health/safety/fundamental rights or lead to prohibited discrimination; (g) measures to detect, prevent and mitigate such biases; (h) identification of data gaps/shortcomings and how addressed. Datasets relevant, sufficiently representative, to the best extent possible free of errors and complete for the intended purpose; appropriate statistical properties incl. for persons/groups on whom the system is used; account for the specific geographical, contextual, behavioural or functional setting. Art. 10(5): processing of special categories of personal data permitted for bias detection/correction under strict safeguards (necessity, no alternatives, security, no onward transfer, deletion). Art. 10(6): systems not using model training still apply (b)–(h) to testing data.
requirements.evidenceHint: Data governance procedure (EV-PROC), datasheets for each dataset incl. provenance, collection, labelling, cleaning (EV-DATA), bias examination report and mitigation record (EV-DATA, EV-TEST), representativeness analysis, special-category-data justification & DPIA (EV-IA). · Tests: T-DQ (completeness, error rate, label quality, representativeness vs target population, leakage, duplication), T-BIAS (bias-in-data and bias-in-output analyses), T-PRIV (special-category handling checks).

requirements.title: Technical documentation (+ Annex IV)
requirements.description: Draw up technical documentation before placing on market/putting into service and keep it up to date; demonstrate compliance with Section 2; contain at minimum Annex IV elements; SMEs/microenterprises (and under the Omnibus, SMCs) may use a simplified form (Commission template). Annex I products: a single set of documentation.
requirements.evidenceHint: Complete Annex IV technical file (EV-TECHDOC), signed/dated test reports (EV-TEST), datasheets (EV-DATA), DoC copy (EV-DEC), PMM plan (EV-PMM), change log (EV-CHG). · Tests: all test types feed Annex IV §2 (validation & testing) and §3 (capabilities/limitations) — T-ACC, T-ROB, T-BIAS, T-SEC, T-ADV, T-HO.

requirements.title: Record-keeping
requirements.description: Technically allow automatic recording of events (logs) over the system's lifetime; logging capability ensures traceability appropriate to intended purpose, enabling: identification of situations that may present a risk (Art. 79(1)) or substantial modification; facilitating post-market monitoring (Art. 72); monitoring operation by deployers (Art. 26(5)). For Annex III point 1(a) RBI systems, logs include at minimum: period of each use (start/end date-time), reference database against which input data was checked, input data for which search led to a match, identification of natural persons involved in result verification (Art. 14(5)). Retention by provider (Art. 19) and deployer (Art. 26(6)) at least 6 months unless other law.
requirements.evidenceHint: Logging specification, log schema, retention configuration, sample log exports, access controls on logs (EV-LOG, EV-TECHDOC). · Tests: T-LOG (event coverage test, tamper-evidence/integrity test, decision reconstruction test, retention verification); T-AGENT trace logging for agentic systems.

requirements.title: Transparency and provision of information to deployers
requirements.description: Design so operation is sufficiently transparent for deployers to interpret and use output appropriately; accompany with instructions for use (digital or otherwise) containing concise, complete, correct and clear information: (a) provider identity/contact; (b) characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance incl. intended purpose; level of accuracy (incl. metrics), robustness and cybersecurity tested/validated and any known/foreseeable circumstances that may impact them; known/foreseeable circumstances that may lead to risks to health, safety or fundamental rights; technical capabilities and characteristics to provide information relevant to explain output; performance regarding specific persons/groups; specifications for input data, or other information on training/validation/testing data sets; information enabling deployers to interpret output and use it appropriately; (c) pre-determined changes; (d) human oversight measures (Art. 14) incl. technical measures to facilitate interpretation of outputs; (e) computational and hardware resources needed, expected lifetime, necessary maintenance and care measures incl. software updates; (f) description of mechanisms allowing deployers to collect, store and interpret logs.
requirements.evidenceHint: Instructions for use / deployer documentation (EV-UI, EV-TECHDOC), model/system card, declared metrics (EV-TEST). · Tests: T-ACC (metrics declared must be reproduced), T-EXP (explanation capability verification), T-TRANS (documentation completeness check), deployer comprehension T-UX.

requirements.title: Human oversight
requirements.description: Design (incl. human-machine interface tools) so natural persons can effectively oversee during use; aim to prevent/minimise risks to health, safety, fundamental rights; measures built-in by provider and/or identified for deployer implementation; oversight persons enabled, as appropriate and proportionate, to: (a) properly understand relevant capacities and limitations and duly monitor operation incl. to detect and address anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance; (b) remain aware of automation bias; (c) correctly interpret output considering available interpretation tools/methods; (d) decide not to use the system or otherwise disregard, override or reverse output; (e) intervene in operation or interrupt via a "stop" button or similar procedure allowing halt in a safe state. Art. 14(5): for Annex III 1(a) RBI, no action/decision on the basis of identification unless separately verified and confirmed by at least two competent natural persons (exceptions for law enforcement/migration where disproportionate).
requirements.evidenceHint: Human-oversight design specification, HMI description, operator procedures, training materials for oversight staff (EV-TECHDOC, EV-PROC, EV-TRAIN), oversight test records (EV-TEST), override/stop logs (EV-LOG). · Tests: T-HO (HITL escalation test, override/reversal test, stop-button/safe-state test, anomaly alerting test, automation-bias UX study, two-person verification workflow test for RBI), T-AGENT (approval gates on agent actions), T-UX.

requirements.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
requirements.description: Achieve appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity and perform consistently throughout life cycle; Commission to encourage benchmarks/measurement methodologies; declare accuracy levels and relevant metrics in instructions for use; be as resilient as possible to errors, faults or inconsistencies within the system or its environment, incl. through technical redundancy (backup or fail-safe plans); systems that continue learning after deployment address risk of biased outputs feeding back (feedback loops) with mitigation; resilient to attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter use, outputs or performance by exploiting vulnerabilities; cybersecurity solutions appropriate to circumstances and risks; measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control attacks incl. data poisoning, model poisoning, adversarial examples / model evasion, confidentiality attacks, and model flaws.
requirements.evidenceHint: Accuracy/robustness/cybersecurity test reports (EV-TEST), declared metrics in IFU (EV-UI), threat model & security architecture (EV-TECHDOC), redundancy/fail-safe design, feedback-loop controls, penetration/red-team reports (EV-TEST). · Tests: T-ACC (accuracy metrics per task and per subgroup, calibration), T-ROB (perturbation, distribution shift, stress, fault injection, fail-safe behaviour), T-ADV (adversarial examples, evasion, poisoning probes), T-SEC (prompt injection, jailbreak, data/model extraction, confidentiality attacks, supply-chain vulnerability scan, OWASP LLM Top-10 coverage), T-DRIFT (feedback-loop/bias drift monitoring), T-RT.

requirements.title: Obligations of providers of high-risk AI systems
requirements.description: Providers shall: (a) ensure compliance with Section 2; (b) indicate name, registered trade name/mark and contact address on the system or, where not possible, packaging/documentation; (c) have a QMS (Art. 17); (d) keep documentation (Art. 18 — 10 years); (e) keep automatically generated logs under their control (Art. 19 — ≥6 months); (f) ensure the conformity assessment procedure (Art. 43) before placing on market; (g) draw up EU declaration of conformity (Art. 47); (h) affix CE marking (Art. 48); (i) comply with registration (Art. 49); (j) take corrective actions and provide information (Art. 20); (k) upon reasoned request, demonstrate conformity to a national competent authority; (l) ensure accessibility requirements per Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882.
requirements.evidenceHint: Provider obligations checklist, labelling/identification evidence (EV-UI), QMS manual (EV-PROC), document retention records, DoC (EV-DEC), CE marking evidence, EU database registration confirmation (EV-DEC), corrective action records (EV-INC, EV-CHG), accessibility conformance report. · Tests: T-CONF; accessibility testing (WCAG/EN 301 549) as T-UX.

requirements.title: Quality management system
requirements.description: Put in place a QMS ensuring compliance, documented systematically as written policies, procedures and instructions, including at least:
requirements.evidenceHint: QMS manual and procedures covering (a)–(m) (EV-PROC), ISO 9001/ISO 42001 certificate if used as evidence (EV-DEC), test/validation procedure documents (EV-TEST), data management procedure (EV-DATA), PMM & incident procedures (EV-PMM, EV-INC), accountability framework (EV-RACI), internal audit of QMS (EV-AUDIT). · Tests: T-CONF (QMS audit); test-procedure execution evidence from all T-* types under (d).

requirements.title: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems

requirements.title: Fundamental rights impact assessment (FRIA)

Notify market surveillance authority of results (template questionnaire from AI Office, possibly automated tool); may rely on DPIA where overlapping; update when elements change. Omnibus: FRIA timing follows the Annex III high-risk date (2 Dec 2027) V.

requirements.title: Conformity assessment

Annex III points 2–8: internal control (Annex VI), no notified body. Annex I Section A products: follow the sectoral third-party conformity procedure with Section 2 requirements and Annex VII points 4.3–4.5 and 4.6 fifth paragraph integrated. New conformity assessment on substantial modification (changes pre-determined by provider and assessed at initial assessment are not substantial modifications); continuously learning systems' pre-determined changes covered. Commission may amend Annexes VI/VII and shift points 2–8 to third-party assessment by delegated act.
